thread:
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-service errors spike in production (error_rate >= 12% for 3m). Incident ID: INC-2026-457. Primary on-call: Lana.
PagerDuty: Automated page fired to Lana (primary). Escalation policy: inference-prod -> secondary after 3 mins.
Lana: acked. I'm up, checking logs and recent deploys.
Lana: first look - stack traces pointing to kv-cache miss + OOM-ish traces on gpu-node-7. Querying metrics.
Sahil: saw the alert, not yet paged to me. If primary doesn't ack within policy will escalate — keeping eyes.
PagerDuty: Escalation: Primary did not acknowledge within 3m, paging secondary: Sahil.
Sahil: acked. Jumping in, pulling recent rollout diffs. Who pushed the 03:02 deploy?
Lana: deploy metadata shows rollout 03:01 by ci-bot -> model-quant-change. Not a full canary. Reverting will take ~6-8m with traffic shift.
Miguel: pinging from manager lane — if rollbacks are required tell me, I'll coordinate customer comms and incident bridge.
Ops-SRE: adding ops checklist: 1) isolate nodes with high OOM, 2) drop to older model variant, 3) enable additional autoscale. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-high-error
Lana: I see GPU mem pressure and kernel failures right before errors. kv-cache eviction rate spiked 4x. Might be quantization memory regression.
Sahil: trying a quick mitigation: reroute 20% of traffic to model-1.7b-safe variant by policy. Applying now:
```
# routing apply
route set inference-service -> model-1.7b-safe weight=20%
```
Lana: routing change applied. Monitoring latency and error rate.
Alice: support reports multiple customer sessions saw 500s and token truncation. CS tagging highest-affected customers; we may need a status page update.
PagerDuty: Note: Manager escalation fired (policy) — Miguel notified.
Miguel: thanks. Once error rate drops below 2% for 5m, we'll close the alert. If rollback required, I'll sign off. Also prepping a short status for customers.
Ops-SRE: ephemeral mitigation looks promising: error rate dipped to 6% after reroute. Still above SLO. Next step: increase safe-variant to 50% and spin up 2 extra nodes in us-west-2.
Sahil: increasing safe-variant to 50% now. Spinning up extra nodes (autoscale override +2).
Lana: errors down to 1.7% — looks within SLO. Watching for regressions.
Alice: notifying affected customers with a brief note: 'We observed elevated errors between 03:01-03:10 UTC, mitigation in progress, may have impacted inference calls'.
Incident-Bot: Incident INC-2026-457 marked as mitigated (error_rate < 2% for 5m). Incident state: mitigated -> monitor.
Miguel: good work. Postmortem owners? Lana + Sahil + Ops-SRE. Please capture root cause (quantization change + cache eviction cascade) and action items: stronger canary gating, autoscale safety buffer, alert tuning for kv-cache spikes.
Lana: I'll start the postmortem draft and link the runbook steps and timeline.
Sahil: adding a follow-up to validate model-quant memory profile in staging and add synthetic kv-cache pressure tests.
Miguel: I'll coordinate a one-hour post-incident review with CS and SRE tomorrow.
Incident-Bot: Reminder: add follow-up tags: postmortem_needed, customer_communication, autorevert-evaluation.
Lana: closing thread here. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
